scripts.build: npm run check && npm test && npm run build:bundle
scripts.check: set "PATH=%USERPROFILE%\.cargo\bin;%PATH%" && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all -- --check && cargo clippy --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings -D clippy::undocumented_unsafe_blocks
scripts.test: npm run test:ui && npm run test:ocr-matcher && npm run test:catalog-admin && set "PATH=%USERPROFILE%\.cargo\bin;%PATH%" && cargo test --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets
